name: ios
description: Apple platform app development in Swift (SwiftUI + UIKit): building, designing and shipping apps for iPhone Duo — resizability, vertical bars, fold-aware layouts and arrangement views, hinge and multi-scene APIs, dual-display camera capture, design/UX/accessibility review, testing and App Store launch, the command-line Xcode loop (ios-xcode-cli) and an end-to-end release playbook (ios-release-playbook).
